cases.title: Personal record binding
cases.expected: Own record/item/workspace stays consistent for direct insert/update and legitimate relink; foreign substitution is denied without side effects.

cases.title: Family membership and attribution
cases.expected: Head/member/outsider access, invitation removal and paid-by attribution obey installed permissions and head entitlements.

cases.title: Business role and scope finance
cases.expected: Owner/manager/staff/viewer scopes isolate expenses, reports, receipts and cross-workspace records.

cases.title: Schedule and history integrity
cases.expected: Recurring/custom-day and one-off records preserve due dates, paid state and history across month/timezone changes.

cases.title: Currency and rates
cases.expected: USD/INR totals round consistently; actual automatic scheduler/provider execution and historical conversions are preserved.

cases.title: Cashbook and entitlements
cases.expected: Existing payment selection, duplicate protection, reports and expiry/free-limit behavior retain correct records and access.

cases.title: Signup and confirmation
cases.expected: Separate controlled identities confirm using deployed callbacks; unconfirmed users do not gain forbidden access.

cases.title: Invitation and identity linking
cases.expected: Fresh, expired, reused and wrong-account invitations preserve intended identity/workspace and fail safely.

cases.title: Password and recovery
cases.expected: Actual password enforcement, current/recent-login requirements and recovery links match the accepted policy.

cases.title: Session and account switching
cases.expected: Refresh, logout, offline/transient failures and late callbacks do not expose previous-account data.

cases.title: Admin MFA and recovery
cases.expected: Verified controlled operators prove AAL2 and role checks plus recovery without risking sole-operator lockout.

cases.title: Direct caller and grants
cases.expected: Real allowed and denied database/API callers prove RLS, routines, escalation and effective grants independent of UI.

cases.title: Trusted upload processing
cases.expected: Actual bytes, content/size limits, quotas and rate limits are checked at the trusted boundary.

cases.title: Proof access and context
cases.expected: Own permitted proofs open; foreign/stale context cannot sign, read or remove another workspace's object.

cases.title: Account deletion and ownership
cases.expected: Recoverable isolated deletion honors ownership transfer, shared finance retention and authenticated subject selection.

cases.title: Cleanup and retry
cases.expected: Actual durable jobs remove approved files/provider data, recover interrupted work and avoid false completion.

cases.title: Data inventory and declarations
cases.expected: Installed analytics, processors, SDKs and logs match public privacy and store declarations.

cases.title: Audience and retention
cases.expected: Accepted child/audience/territory/consent decisions and category retention/deletion are implemented and demonstrated.

cases.title: Cold and warm startup
cases.expected: Recorded device/network/data-size timings and failures meet approved budgets; legitimate missing-workspace provisioning stays bounded.

cases.title: Responsive finance and input
cases.expected: Narrow/large screens, keyboard, zoom, focus/error labels and form submission remain usable without cut-off controls.

cases.title: Dashboard and reports
cases.expected: Independent month selectors, carryover, paid-by, sorting and filters remain accurate for controlled datasets.

cases.title: Realtime and repeated operations
cases.expected: Update/entry/delete and reconnect refresh the affected context; concurrent or repeated actions avoid duplicate finance records.

cases.title: Offline and account privacy
cases.expected: Private/API requests are not exposed by offline cache; account switch and network failures display truthful safe state.

cases.title: Update and interruption
cases.expected: Old/current service workers, multiple tabs, dirty forms, in-flight saves and resume preserve accepted update behavior.

cases.title: Source and deployment pins
cases.expected: Frontend, Edge functions, schema, grants and configuration are reconciled to installed staging identities.

cases.title: Release asset completeness
cases.expected: All entry pages and referenced helpers including auth.html, auth-flows.js and auth-security.js exist in the actual serving artifact.

cases.title: Transport and serving layer
cases.expected: Actual redirect/header/TLS/origin behavior and serving-layer mapping meet requirements; historical failed production samples remain visible.

cases.title: Notification destination and content
cases.expected: Installed egress/recipient/preview controls reject invalid or inactive recipients and preserve private display rules.

cases.title: Scheduler and durable queue
cases.expected: Real controlled jobs establish concurrency, reclaim/stale-result behavior, partial delivery and recovery without unintended sends.

cases.title: Support and operational routing
cases.expected: Controlled faults reach monitored support/alerts; quota, ownership, incident and recovery procedures are executable.

cases.title: Android identity and signing
cases.expected: Final signed AAB/APK identity, version, toolchain and merged manifest are evidenced with signing material kept private.

cases.title: iOS archive and privacy
cases.expected: Final iOS archive, signing, SDKs, privacy manifests and required API reasons match shipped behavior.

cases.title: Native Auth return
cases.expected: Physical-device cold/warm callbacks and wrong/stale/reused links preserve identity, session and route boundaries.

cases.title: Backup and token persistence
cases.expected: Final platform backup exclusions and actual device restore/session storage prevent unintended recovery of private credentials.

cases.title: Native push lifecycle
cases.expected: Implemented transport, permission, registration, foreground/background and multi-account cleanup are verified on controlled devices.

cases.title: Device compatibility and recovery
cases.expected: Accepted OS/device matrix covers rotation, resume, upgrades, crash recovery and no irreversible data loss.

cases.title: Publisher accounts and roles
cases.expected: Current account type, identity/verification and authorized publishing/recovery roles are evidenced privately.

cases.title: Google required testing
cases.expected: Account-specific console requirements, continuous opted-in testing where applicable, engagement and production-access decision are evidenced.

cases.title: TestFlight beta evidence
cases.expected: Exact approved build, testing scope, tester feedback and crash outcomes are evidenced; approval is not assumed.

cases.title: Reviewer access and listings
cases.expected: Working controlled review identities/resources and truthful screenshots, descriptions, support/URLs enable full feature review.

cases.title: Commerce and availability
cases.expected: Approved territory/channel catalog, purchases/restores/refunds and expiry match Stage 7 controls and store rules.

cases.title: Privacy and account deletion
cases.expected: Data safety/App Privacy/audience/permissions/SDK disclosures and usable deletion resources match the final app.

cases.title: Coverage traceability
cases.expected: All 123 original rows and 20 findings link to dated results for exact source/deployment/artifact identities.

cases.title: Regression completeness
cases.expected: Discovered MJS/CJS files and explicit local verifiers have executed/excluded/blocked dispositions; failures and repeats remain separate.

cases.title: Backup and recovery proof
cases.expected: Recoverable backup/restore and incident exercises cover the final accepted system and preserve audit evidence.

cases.title: Release and rollback package
cases.expected: Accepted rollout/rollback ownership and steps reconcile serving layers, schema, settings and artifact versions.

cases.title: Known gaps and release decision
cases.expected: Every open action has an owner and accepted evidence/disposition; missing hosted/device evidence cannot become fixture PASS.

cases.title: Full fresh re-audit
cases.expected: Final source, installed systems and signed artifacts undergo required complete re-audit before release authorization.
